subject: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort
body:
From: Maya Patel <maya@edgescale.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@edgescale.io
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well — we spoke briefly at the CloudSummit last month. EdgeScale’s next accelerator cohort kicks off April 6 and we’re evaluating partner credits to give each startup a fast ramp on Redwood for their POCs.

High level ask: would Redwood approve a pool of sandbox/promotional credits we can allocate across up to 12 startups? Suggested baseline: 100,000 token-equivalent credits per team (50K text + 50K embeddings) for 90 days. We can commit to the cohort using the Redwood hosted API and feature Redwood in our partner communication.

Attached is the cohort roster and a short one-pager on our program. We’d like to finalize commitments by end of next week to include in the welcome pack.

Two quick notes:
- We prefer credits to be redeemable only for non-production environments (sandbox) and to have usage controls at the account level.
- If there’s a standard partner credit agreement / DocuSign you prefer, please send and we’ll route internally.

Appreciate any guidance — happy to hop on a 20m call if easier.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Director, Partnerships | EdgeScale Accelerator

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@edgescale.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort

Hi Maya — great to hear from you and congrats on the new cohort. Short answer: we can make a partner credit pool work, but I need to confirm a couple of details with Finance and Channel.

Can you confirm:
- Final headcount (you mentioned up to 12 — is that fixed or a cap?)
- Whether startups will each have a unique billing/account identity (preferred) or whether you want a pooled account managed by EdgeScale ops
- Any compliance requirements for the cohort (country restrictions, data residency, need for an on-prem option)

Jordan/Ben — looping you in to estimate cost and confirm process. If we can greenlight the standard promo credit (100K token-equivalent per startup for 90 days) I’ll send a provisional commitment and ask legal to prepare a short partner credit agreement.

Maya — if you can return the cohort roster with company domains by EOD Wed (Mar 18) we’ll try to lock in allocation and send the DocuSign link. If anything needs faster turnaround, I’m available Wed morning 8–10am PT for a quick check-in.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0122

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort

Lauren — thanks for the heads-up. Finance perspective / suggested guardrails:
- Scope: up to 12 startups, we’ll provision 100K token-equivalent per startup initially (same split as requested).
- Spend cap: Set a per-account soft cap at 120K tokens with auto-disable and notifications at 80% to prevent overruns.
- Accounting: Book as partner marketing/promotions (code PM-ACCEL-2026). Estimated gross cost if fully utilized: ~USD 3,600 (assuming hosted API average cost per 1K tokens for this promo configuration).
- Approval: Ben — can you confirm we can absorb this under Q2 partner promo budget? If it’s higher than expected we’ll route a quick approval to Ops lead.

Also recommend we require each startup to sign a short Acceptable Use Addendum (AUA) acknowledging sandbox use and data retention expectations (30 days). I can draft a one-pager.

Jordan Blake
Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort

Jordan / Lauren — we have enough runway in Q2 partner promo to cover the estimated cost. Approve provisional allocation under PM-ACCEL-2026, with the following conditions:
1) EdgeScale provides finalized roster with company names + domains
2) Credits are time-limited (90 days) and non-transferable
3) EdgeScale signs our Partner Credit Agreement (I’ll coordinate with Legal)
4) We enforce usage caps and alerts (Jordan will own the caps)

Happy to sign off on this — Ben
Ben Carter
Finance (Sales Ops) | Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@edgescale.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sandbox credits for EdgeScale Accelerator cohort

Maya — good news: we can provision the pilot as requested. Provisional terms below (will mirror in DocuSign):
- Allocation: up to 12 startups, 100,000 token-equivalent per startup (50K text / 50K embeddings)
- Term: 90 days from activation date
- Controls: per-account soft cap (120K) with auto-disable and alerts at 80%
- Non-production only (sandbox) and non-transferable
- Required: signed Partner Credit Agreement + short AUA per startup

Next steps for EdgeScale ops: please reply with the final roster (company name + company domain) and confirm whether you want Redwood to create accounts directly or provision a pooled account we can tie to a billing alias. Once we have that, I’ll send the DocuSign link for the partner credit agreement and loop Legal to review the AUA.

If you want an SSO enablement or test keys beforehand, we can provide a temporary shared key for the cohort onboarding.

Looking forward — target to activate credits by Apr 1 if we receive the roster this week.

Best,
Lauren
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: EdgeScale_Cohort_Summary.xlsx (roster, proposed allocation) ; EdgeAccel_SLA_and_Terms_v1.pdf
